repository_read_rule: Analyze the pinned git_head with read-only git show commands; ignore later working-tree changes, do not switch checkouts, and do not modify either sample repository.

response_contract.case_rule: Assess every repository except change_project exactly once.
response_contract.evidence_fields: project_id, path, and either line_start plus line_end or symbol
